requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the arrest, exactly as the arrest record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the arrest, exactly as the arrest record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the arrest date, copied exactly from the arrest record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name of the arresting agency, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name of the arresting agency, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: an agency name is a case fact the participant can obtain, not a field the court owns
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the arresting agency, from the arrest record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case or incident number of the arrest, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case or incident number of the arrest, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no record identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case or incident number, copied from the arrest record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date 90 days after the finding, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date 90 days after the finding, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the deadline is computed from a date the platform does not hold
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the calculated date 90 days after the finding - the agency's expired deadline

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the agency's mistaken-identity finding, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the agency's mistaken-identity finding, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the 90-day deadline runs from a finding the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the agency's finding, copied from the finding itself

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Identifiers used on the arrest record, listed on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Identifiers used on the arrest record, listed on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: what identifiers the arrest was recorded under lives on a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and any other identifiers under which the arrest was recorded, copied from the arrest paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Judicial district and county named in the caption - where the arrest occurred
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Judicial district and county named in the caption - where the arrest occurred
requiredBeforeFiling.why: where the arrest occurred is a fact of the participant's record, and the statute fixes venue there
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the judicial district where the arrest occurred, and its county - the district court's own office can confirm both

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Complete record-custodian list - the offices known to hold records of the arrest
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Complete record-custodian list - the offices known to hold records of the arrest
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which offices hold records of a particular arrest lives in paperwork the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: every office known to hold records of the arrest, taken from your arrest paperwork - the proposed order directs the custodians on this list

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier exists before the court assigns one
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number the court assigns at filing, once it exists

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Judicial district and county named in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Judicial district and county named in the caption of the proposed order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the proposed order travels with the petition and carries the same caption the participant establishes
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same judicial district and county you wrote in the petition's caption

protectedBlanks.label: Case number of this petition, assigned by the clerk at filing
protectedBlanks.why: the clerk assigns the number at filing

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of the petitioner on the petition
protectedBlanks.why: the petitioner signs the petition personally

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the petitioner's signature on the petition
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the petition is signed would be false

protectedBlanks.label: The decision line of the proposed order, decided by the court
protectedBlanks.why: every decision on the proposed order is the court's

protectedBlanks.label: Signature line of the proposed order, for the court
protectedBlanks.why: the court signs the order if, and only if, it grants the petition

protectedBlanks.label: Date line of the proposed order, for the court
protectedBlanks.why: the court dates the order when it decides
